title: 稳定子态的 Pauli 谱计数
statement: For a pure n-qubit stabilizer state the signed Pauli spectrum has d^2-d zero entries and d entries equal to plus or minus one.
assumptions: The state is a normalized pure n-qubit stabilizer state.
d=2^n; phase-free Pauli labels are used, retaining the sign and multiplicity of each expectation.
objects: psi: rank-one density operator on (C^2)^{tensor n}
Spec(psi): multiset of tr(psi P) for phase-free Pauli strings P
error_bound: Not applicable: exact asserted counting identities.
gaps: No independent proof or source-to-formal alignment performed; signed-group versus phase-free-label identification must remain explicit.

title: Pauli 零谱条目与 nullity 的界
statement: The authors bound the number of vanishing Pauli expectations of a pure state using its stabilizer nullity.
assumptions: psi is a normalized pure n-qubit state.
nu(psi)=n-log_2|Stab(psi)|; Ker_P(psi) contains phase-free Paulis with zero expectation.
gaps: The cited support/nullity comparison has not been retrieved or independently checked.

title: 配分函数的高温与零温极限
statement: The stabilizer partition function tends to the number of Pauli labels as beta tends to zero and to half the stabilizer-group cardinality as beta tends to positive infinity.
assumptions: psi is a fixed normalized pure n-qubit state; d=2^n.
Z_beta(psi)=exp(-beta) sum_{x in Spec(psi)} cosh(beta x).
beta is a mathematical parameter, not a physical inverse temperature.
error_bound: Limit identities; no finite-beta convergence rate extracted.
gaps: Limits and finite-beta estimates must not be conflated.
The subsequent support/kernel rewrite at lines 553-555 appears to omit beta inside cosh; not silently used to redefine Z.

title: 配分函数的 Clifford 不变性
statement: The stabilizer partition function is invariant under Clifford conjugation of a pure state.
assumptions: psi is a normalized pure n-qubit state; beta is real.
C is an n-qubit Clifford unitary; C(psi)=C psi C^dagger.
SPF uses cosh of signed expectations, not a labelled-spectrum identity.
gaps: The proof's assertion about sorting signed spectra needs review because Clifford conjugation can flip signs; no proof repair is made here.

title: 稳定子参考配分函数
statement: All pure n-qubit stabilizer states have the same SPF, with the stated closed-form core SPF.
assumptions: phi is a normalized pure n-qubit stabilizer state; d=2^n; beta is real.
Z_beta^c=Z_beta-d^2 exp(-beta).
gaps: A common value on stabilizer states is not by itself an iff characterization at every beta; at beta=0 SPF is state-independent.

title: 配分函数与整数阶稳定子熵的展开
statement: The authors express SPF through the hierarchy of integer-index stabilizer Renyi entropies, retaining the universal zeroth and second-moment terms.
assumptions: psi is a normalized pure n-qubit state; d=2^n; beta is real.
M_k is the source's base-two stabilizer Renyi entropy; k is an integer at least two in the sum.
error_bound: Infinite-series identity; no truncation guarantee follows without a separate bound.
gaps: This even-moment object does not recover the labelled signed Pauli spectrum; claims about full spectrum must respect the qualification at lines 570-573.

title: 配分函数的连续性界
statement: The SPF difference for two pure n-qubit states is bounded by an explicit coefficient times the trace norm of the projector difference.
assumptions: psi and phi denote normalized pure-state projectors on the same n-qubit space.
beta is real; d=2^n; ||.||_1 is the trace norm, not an independently renormalized trace distance.
error_bound: The displayed coefficient is the author's asserted bound, not independently checked.
gaps: Supplementary proof has not been reconstructed or validated in this Paper pass.

title: Bell 采样估计：固定截断不等于全参数高效
statement: The authors describe Bell-sampling access to a finite-order truncated SPF for fixed order and beta, with additive accuracy and failure probability; full normalized SPF additionally needs a truncation bound.
assumptions: Fixed truncation order k and parameter beta; repeated state copies and the cited Bell-sampling primitive are available.
Accuracy epsilon, failure probability delta, normalization and truncation error must be tracked separately.
conclusion: A fixed-order moment estimator is postprocessed into a truncated SPF estimate; no uniform cost bound for arbitrary beta or the unnormalized full SPF is extracted here.
error_bound: Residual: reconcile the informal main theorem with supplementary estimator concentration and normalized/full SPF conventions.
gaps: This deliberately remains a residual scientific claim rather than an underspecified MathClaim.
No sampling experiment or empirical runtime measurement was performed.

title: 纯态配分函数的状态无关上下界
statement: For pure n-qubit states the authors give stabilizer-valued upper and uniform-nonidentity-spectrum lower bounds on SPF.
assumptions: psi is a normalized pure n-qubit state, beta is real, d=d_n=2^n.
Identifying the unindexed d in the source denominator with d_n is an explicit extraction convention awaiting review.
error_bound: Not applicable: asserted inequalities; achievability of a uniform spectrum is not established by this extraction.
gaps: The proof expansion appears to omit the exp(-beta) factor; statement is preserved, not repaired.
Source notation d versus d_n requires alignment review.
